items.item_text: American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross Basic Life Support (BLS), or UC Davis Health CPR
Licensed by the Medical Board of California as a Polysomnographic Technologist or must be in progress (documentation will be requested) and current by the time of hire
2 years of experience as a Registered Polysom Tech

The Senior Polysomnographic Technologist performs advanced diagnostic and therapeutic sleep studies for hospital inpatients and outpatients across the lifespan, including routine and complex polysomnography, portable sleep testing, and Home Sleep Testing. This role is responsible for accurately scoring and interpreting sleep study data while ensuring the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care that supports accurate diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders.

Working under the clinical direction of the Neurodiagnostic Services Supervisor, Medical Directors, and Program Manager, the Senior Polysomnographic Technologist serves as an experienced clinical resource, contributing to the technical quality of sleep studies and supporting efficient laboratory operations. In addition to direct patient care, this position performs front office and administrative functions for the assigned clinical team, provides backup support as needed, and fosters a welcoming, compassionate environment that promotes exceptional patient experiences and operational excellence.
Accomplish a variety of concurrent assignments effectively and efficiently
Organizes and prioritizes assignments to complete work in a timely and efficient manner, particularly when there are changes in workload or assignments
Remains flexible and adaptable to changes in policies and procedures
Interpersonal communication skills to interact with tact and diplomacy with hospital and clinic patients, physicians, and staff at all levels
Ability to engage in collaborative problem-solving with coworkers and staff
Must have the ability to function as a “team player,” being considerate and flexible, considering the needs of your peers
Ability to exercise discretion to ensure that patient confidentiality is maintained, and a professional, respectful hospital, clinic, or laboratory environment exists at all times

Ability to maintain composure, efficiency, and a positive, customer-service oriented manner during periods of peak workload, with frequent interruptions, under tight deadlines, and when interacting with patients who are ill, angry, or emotionally distressed

Written and oral communication skills to clearly provide information, explanations, and instructions to, and to elicit information from others with varying levels of ability to understand, including individuals who are ill or distressed, or for whom English may be a second language
Filing skills to maintain physical and digital logs and files of information in alphabetical, chronological, and/ or numerical order, such that it is current and easily retrievable
